clue.text: Charged for contract

definitions.meaning: charged as in highly strung, full of nervous excitement
to contract a muscle is to tighten it

explanation.surface: A billing query: what was charged for drawing up a contract.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses fit: an anxious, wound-up person is charged with nerves, and muscles tighten when they contract.

clue.text: Dog happy to see something on vehicle

parts.note: to dog someone is to follow them closely, to tail them
light as in light-hearted, cheerful

explanation.surface: A dog is pleased to spot something on a passing car.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dog' reads as the animal but is the verb meaning follow.
explanation.definitionFit: The red lamp at the rear of a car is one thing fitted on a vehicle.

clue.text: Name deadly female hidden in old province

indicators.note: hidden here means the female letter is put out of sight, taken away from the word for deadly

parts.note: deadly means fatal

explanation.surface: A lethal woman lies concealed somewhere in a former province.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hidden' looks like a hidden-word signal, but here it removes F from FATAL, leaving ATAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Natal was a province of South Africa until 1994, now part of KwaZulu-Natal.

clue.text: Later period matching trend

parts.note: even means level, equal, matching
a tide is a general drift or trend, as in the tide of opinion

explanation.surface: A later era that follows the current fashion.
explanation.definitionFit: Evening is the later part of the day, the period this old poetic word names.

clue.text: Soon to host contest, leader of men who took 24's place

indicators.note: to host is to have inside, so the word for soon takes the other pieces into it

parts.note: anon is an old word for soon
a game is a contest

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter, here of men

explanation.surface: Shortly a contest will be staged, featuring a leader of men who replaced someone.
explanation.walkthrough: 24 is PRIAM, king of Troy, whose city the Greeks took under this commander.
explanation.definitionFit: The Greek king who led the sack of Troy took the city ruled by King Priam.

clue.text: Alpha male in scrap

parts.note: A is alpha in the phonetic alphabet
a tom is a male animal, especially a cat

explanation.surface: The dominant man in a group is caught up in a fight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Alpha male' reads as one phrase, but splits into A and TOM; 'scrap' is a tiny bit, not a fight.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiny particle or smallest bit of something, as in not an atom of truth.

clue.text: Things going on a long time after a very quiet death

indicators.note: after places the long time later than the other pieces

parts.note: PP, pianissimo, is the musical mark for very quiet
an end is a death
ages means a long time

explanation.surface: Events dragging on long after a peaceful death.
explanation.definitionFit: Attachments are parts added on to something larger, things that go on it.

clue.text: City den offers something sweet

parts.note: EC is the postcode for the City of London
a lair is an animal's den

explanation.surface: A city den serves a treat.
explanation.definitionFit: A cream-filled choux pastry is a sweet treat.

clue.text: Fresh delivery for Brooklyn addressee?

parts.note: fresh means new
a yorker is a cricket ball bowled to land at the batsman's feet

explanation.surface: A new parcel arrives for someone at a Brooklyn address.
explanation.walkthrough: A yorker is a cricket delivery pitched right at the batsman's feet.
explanation.definitionFit: Brooklyn is a borough of the US city, so anyone addressed there lives in it.

clue.text: Message sensibly conveyed in this bottle

definitions.meaning: a fibre carrying signals from the senses to the brain
bottle is British slang for courage

explanation.surface: A message in a bottle, sensibly sent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sensibly' means by way of the senses; bottle is British slang for courage.
explanation.definitionFit: Sensory impulses travel along a fibre of the body, and the same word means courage or daring.

clue.text: Expecting trouble, he is put on manoeuvres

indicators.note: manoeuvres, as a verb, means the letters before it are steered around into a new order

explanation.surface: A soldier sent on exercises anticipates difficulty.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes someone in a mess, facing difficulty.

clue.text: Maybe ox is to appear menacing

definitions.meaning: cattle moo, so an ox is one that lows
to look threatening, frown darkly, as storm clouds do

explanation.surface: An ox that looks threatening.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as LOW-ER the word is a mooer; read with the other pronunciation it means scowl.
explanation.definitionFit: One that moos, and a verb meaning scowl or look dark and threatening, both share this spelling.

clue.text: Haze affected toil in smoggy city

indicators.note: in puts the rearranged letters inside the city

parts.note: LA, Los Angeles, is famous for smog

indicators.note: affected means altered, so the letters of toil are changed in order

explanation.surface: Smog has damaged work in a polluted city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Haze' looks like smog but is a surname: Dolores Haze is Nabokov's heroine.
explanation.definitionFit: Dolores Haze is the girl in Nabokov's novel, known by her nickname.

clue.text: Learner driver leaving road, running over cat, is tragedy

indicators.note: running over means the remaining road letters run around the cat, enclosing it
leaving means the learner departs, taken out of the road

parts.note: a lane is a road
L is the learner driver's plate
a tigon is a big cat, a tiger-lion cross

explanation.surface: A learner swerves off the road and runs over a cat: a tragedy.
explanation.walkthrough: The cat is not a moggy but the tigon, a tiger-lion hybrid; 'running over' means the trimmed road wraps round it.
explanation.definitionFit: Sophocles wrote the Greek tragedy about the daughter of Oedipus.

clue.text: Broken rule?

parts.note: a rule is a printed line, and a broken one is a line made of dots, where one signs

explanation.surface: Somebody has broken a rule.
explanation.definitionFit: A ruled line printed in dots is literally broken, as on a form awaiting a signature.

clue.text: Sums together coming to

definitions.meaning: all the sums added up into one figure
coming to as in amounting to, as a bill comes to a figure

explanation.surface: Adding figures together and reaching a result.
explanation.definitionFit: The final figure is all the sums added, which is what a bill comes to.

clue.text: PM seeking news about old love

parts.note: after as in going after, seeking

indicators.note: about means the news letters go around the other pieces

parts.note: N is new, so NN stands for news as two Ns
love is zero in tennis, shaped like O

explanation.surface: A Prime Minister hunting for stories about a former lover.
explanation.walkthrough: 'PM' looks like the Prime Minister but means post meridiem.
explanation.definitionFit: PM, post meridiem, marks the hours after midday.

clue.text: Birds migrating west to find another

indicators.note: in an across clue, travelling west means reading right to left

parts.note: auks are seabirds

explanation.surface: Birds fly west and meet another kind of bird.
explanation.definitionFit: Another, after birds, means another bird; a great seabird of the gull family is meant.

clue.text: Baggage southern family hauled up to Scotland

indicators.note: to means joined on to the Scottish piece, after it

parts.note: Alba is the Gaelic name for Scotland

indicators.note: in a down clue, hauled up means the letters are read bottom to top

parts.note: a sort is a kind or family

explanation.surface: A southern family's luggage hauled north to Scotland.
explanation.walkthrough: Baggage here is a burden, the bird the Ancient Mariner had to wear.
explanation.definitionFit: A burden that hangs round one's neck, from Coleridge's Mariner: figurative heavy baggage.

clue.text: Reliable rig that's exploded

indicators.note: exploded means blown apart, so the letters fly into a new order

explanation.surface: An oil rig that blew up, though said to be trustworthy.
explanation.definitionFit: Honest or dependable, as a straight dealer is.

clue.text: Old marshal and sea god Royal Navy separately dismissed

indicators.note: separately dismissed means the two navy letters leave one at a time from different places

parts.note: Triton is a Greek sea god
RN is the Royal Navy

explanation.surface: An old marshal and a sea god are both thrown out by the navy.
explanation.definitionFit: Marshal Josip Broz led Yugoslavia, known by his nom de guerre.

clue.text: Stray south with sailors rounding bay?

indicators.note: rounding means the south and sailors pieces go round the tree

parts.note: TAR and AB are both words for a sailor
a bay is a laurel tree

explanation.surface: A stray drifts south with sailors sailing round a bay.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bay?' looks like a stretch of coast but is the laurel tree, hence the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: A dated term for a homeless child roaming the streets, a stray.

clue.text: Dramatist is sick individual

parts.note: one means a single individual
ill means sick

explanation.surface: A playwright is unwell.
explanation.definitionFit: Eugene, the American playwright of Long Day's Journey into Night.

clue.text: Still holding onto an old penny piece

indicators.note: holding means the still word clasps the other letters inside

parts.note: serene means still, calm
D, from denarius, was the old British penny

explanation.surface: Still clutching an old penny coin.
explanation.walkthrough: D was the abbreviation for a penny in pre-1971 British money.
explanation.definitionFit: A piece of music sung or played under a window at night.

clue.text: Girl's given lift: it's a Formula One champion!

indicators.note: in a down clue, given a lift means the letters are raised, read upwards

parts.note: Anne's, a girl's name with the possessive S

explanation.surface: A girl is given a ride: her driver is a champion racer.
explanation.definitionFit: Ayrton, the Brazilian driver, won the Formula One title three times.

clue.text: Find faults with film lecture

parts.note: to carp is to find fault, to complain
ET, Spielberg's alien film

explanation.surface: Criticising a film talk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lecture' looks like a noun but is the verb, to reprimand.
explanation.definitionFit: To call someone on the carpet is to reprimand, to scold them.

clue.text: One in transport used by mum gets dad to Paris

indicators.note: in places the one inside the transport

parts.note: a pram is the baby carriage pushed by a mother
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Mum's pram takes a child to see Dad in Paris.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Paris' looks like the city but is the Trojan prince.
explanation.definitionFit: The king of Troy was father of Paris, the prince who abducted Helen.

clue.text: Second Division game's end?

parts.note: a cut is a division

explanation.surface: A second-division football match nearing its finish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'game' is hunted animals, not a match.
explanation.definitionFit: The short tail of a rabbit or deer, the rear end of a game animal.

clue.text: The writer grumbles about girl

indicators.note: about means turned round, so the letters are read backwards

parts.note: the writer refers to the setter, I
moan means grumbles

explanation.surface: The writer complains about a young woman.
explanation.definitionFit: A girl's given name, as borne by Ruth's mother-in-law in the Bible.

clue.text: As compilers here, noticing anagrams with surprised cry

parts.note: O is an exclamation of surprise

explanation.surface: Setters here spot anagrams and cry out.

clue.text: Countermand posh officer accepting soldiers chasing girl

indicators.note: chasing means coming after the girl

parts.note: Ann is a girl's name
U means upper class, posh

indicators.note: accepting means the officer takes the soldiers inside

parts.note: LT is lieutenant
men as in rank-and-file soldiers

explanation.surface: A posh officer cancels orders and takes troops after a girl.
explanation.definitionFit: A countermand, as a noun, is a cancelling, the voiding of an order.

clue.text: Calms husband fished from river

indicators.note: fished from means pulled out of the river

parts.note: the Thames, London's river

explanation.surface: A husband pulled from the river calms down.
